name: VIP-safe remote request
description: Adds a service that fetches remote data over GET without an uncached request on the page path. On WordPress VIP it delegates to wpcom_vip_file_get_contents(), which caches the body, serves a stale copy when the remote end fails and backs off a failing host; elsewhere it caches successful responses in the object cache and fetches with wp_safe_remote_get(). The timeout and cache TTL are constrained to values VIP's coding standards accept.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the service class. Default 'Inc\Services' matches the rtCamp skeleton.
Directory for the service file. Default 'includes/Services'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Services'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Services'.
Logical client name, e.g. 'events-feed'. Normalised to a PascalCase class name and used as the cache group.
PascalCase class name, derived from name.
Object cache group for responses fetched outside VIP, derived from name.
Plugin or theme slug, used to namespace the object cache so another package cannot collide with it.
Request timeout in seconds, written into the TIMEOUT constant. Capped at 3, the most WordPressVIPMinimum.Performance.RemoteRequestTimeout accepts.
Seconds a successful response is cached, written into the CACHE_TTL constant. No lower than 300, the least WordPressVIPMinimum.Performance.LowExpiryCacheTime accepts.
